La selección óptima del antimicrobiano y su posología en los diferentes síndromes infecciosos requieren también una formación específica y actualizada.

Blood Pressure App Diary is an application that will help you track changes in your blood pressure and heart rate. All you have to do is add your blood pressure and pulse measurements and the app will graph and generate reports that you can share with your doctor or anyone else.
The application does not measure blood pressure.

DISCLAIMER: This app cannot detect, diagnose or treat disease. You should always talk to your doctor.
